en-US.description: The world’s fastest framework for building websites
en-US.longDescription:
Hugo is one of the most popular open-source static site generators.
With its amazing speed and flexibility, Hugo makes building websites fun again.
en-US.name: Hugo
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changes
- Fix typo in AGENTS.md 588241bf @pei711
- tpl/collections: Fix sort when some items lack the sort key a8a8e978 @bep #15523
- warpc, commands: Fix Close of image dispatchers, recover in fast render 3c2f52d4 @bep #15522
- warpc: Fix AVIF encode crashing at encoderSpeed 6 and lower 47425654 @bep #15522
- Fix misc layout lookup issues f3875ec3 @bep #15538 #15540
- tpl/collections: Fix merge of maps with concrete element types b76fde2f @bep #15499
- tpl/tplimpl: Fix shortcode layout lookup in non-default output formats 87e6e14c @jmooring #15536
- langs/i18n: Fix project translations losing to module translations fa5a3d48 @jmooring #15518
- Adjust Exif test to fix now failing deprecation tests 471d0fb3 @bep
- markup/goldmark: Escape passthrough content when no render hook is set e2f66a23 @raghu45345
- tpl: Compare time.Time values by instant in eq, ne, in and uniq 3519196b @jmooring #15577
- Skip content check for static files with the same size and modification time afb2d9ac @bep #15572
- commands: Rebuild assets also mounted as static b755c9d5 @xndvaz #15567
- hugolib: Keep npm installs in their test directory 2056ed69 @xndvaz #15568
- Upgrade to Go 1.27.4 bca2cec8 @bep
- common/htime: Preserve location of time.Time values 59224216 @jmooring #8895 #15565
- markup/highlight: Escape wrapperClass bdde5aa5 @bep
- modules: Restrict vendor module paths to the _vendor directory d41a8a19 @bep
- hugofs: Preserve directory casing in resource matches 5b44cfce @xndvaz #7686 #10112
- config: Make command-line flags override OS environment variables d5ba1aaa @bep #15549 #15550
- tpl/resources: Accept []any of resources in Concat e6a470cb @jmooring #15546
- warpc: Keep function names in WASM binaries, set WebP stack size 1a014e53 @bep #15522
- warpc, commands: Recover from broken WASM instances in the server 5086d5fc @bep #15522
- resources: Resolve remote media type from Hugo's media types 3a1985b1 @AnaTejeda1 #11601
- langs/i18n: Add failing test for project translation precedence 2b0e1e1e @jmooring #15518
- ci: Upgrade setup-ruby and Ruby 185a609e @jmooring
- tpl/strings: Rewrite truncate using the hhtml scanner 6b0c89c3 @bep #15505 #15509
- Remove libsass and the extended build tag c2f9cb82 @bep #15405

- build(deps): bump github.com/bits-and-blooms/bitset 0586add2 @dependabot[bot]
- build(deps): bump github.com/tdewolff/minify/v2 from 2.24.24 to 2.24.25 45dfa4e8 @dependabot[bot]
- build(deps): bump github.com/yuin/goldmark from 1.8.6 to 1.8.7 d2010fcc @dependabot[bot]
- deps: Upgrade github.com/gohugoio/hugo-goldmark-extensions/passthrough v0.5.0 ⇒ v0.6.0 2d6cf3a8 @bep
- deps: Upgrade github.com/bep/imagemeta v1.1.0 ⇒ v1.1.1 b6fa2fe5 @bep
- build(deps): bump golang.org/x/net from 0.61.0 to 0.62.0 fe34313e @dependabot[bot]
- build(deps): bump github.com/tdewolff/minify/v2 from 2.24.22 to 2.24.24 7ff95e04 @dependabot[bot]
